description: §9.1.3–§9.1.5 (AP-CONV-002): strings each grammar accepts and rejects. `valid` is the grammar with the sentences its section adds (a segment never ends with - or holds --, the length limits, P alone, -0, real dates and times); `why` names what rejects a string: "abnf" (grammar.abnf itself), or the sentence of the text. Cases marked with a question follow the reading recorded in QUESTIONS.md. The last rules are the strings §9 defines outside §9.1 (grammar.abnf's last section).
